parameters.content:
### {{CLINIC_NAME}} - Medical Records Management (PET WF6)

**🎯 Purpose:** Ensure all patient data and staff notes are complete and medical records are updated

**🚀 Features:**
• **Data Completeness Checks:** Validates pet history forms and staff notes
• **Smart Reminders:** SMS to clients for incomplete forms, email to staff for missing notes
• **Medical Records Hub:** Automated updates to central medical records database
• **Workflow Orchestration:** Seamless integration with visit completion workflow

**⚡ Workflow Trigger:**
• **Post-Visit Trigger:** Activated by PET WF3 (Visit Completion Orchestrator)

**📊 Integration Points:**
• Medical Records Hub: {{MEDICAL_RECORDS_SHEET_ID}}
• Client Communication: SMS via {{BUSINESS_PHONE_NUMBER}}
• Staff Communication: Email via {{BUSINESS_EMAIL}}
• Form Collection: {{PET_HISTORY_FORM_URL}}

**⚙️ Configuration:**
• Clinic: {{CLINIC_NAME}}
• Wait Time: 1 hour for staff note completion
• Reminder Logic: Conditional based on completion status
• Record Format: Structured medical data with timestamps
